title: 고주파 세부의 밴드 비율 보정
hypothesis: Experiment 60 found that the C2MS spectral angle error lives in the high band (QB SAM 4.576 -> 0.361 deg when only the high band is replaced by the GT) but that an 8x8 local affine band map cannot reach it. Splitting the high band H = y - L(y) of each pixel into its strength |H| and its band ratio H/|H| tells which of the two a correction must change.
control: C2MS (53 QB, 54 GF2/WV3) best.pt of the same seed, unchanged; same models, data and lowpass as experiment 60
reuse: experiment 60 prepare.py for data loading (SHA-256 checked), checkpoint loading, inference, per-pixel angle and the sensor MTF lowpass L; the archived RR means must again be reproduced within 1e-3

phase0.definitions: L = per-band sensor MS MTF blur at full resolution (60); H_y = y - L(y), H_g = g - L(g); per pixel, |H| is the norm of the band vector of H and H/|H| its band ratio; pixels with |H| = 0 keep H

oracles.O1_hf_ratio: L(y) + |H_y| * H_g/|H_g|  (GT band ratio of the high band, C2MS strength)
oracles.O2_hf_strength: L(y) + |H_g| * H_y/|H_y|  (GT strength of the high band, C2MS band ratio)
oracles.O3_hf_along_lf_rule: L(y) + (H_y . u) u with u = L(y)/|L(y)|: keeps only the part of the C2MS high band that follows the local low band color; uses no GT (a rule, not an oracle)

phase0.ga_sensitivity: post-hoc check of experiment 60 Ga, reported only: cross-fitted affine band map with 16x16 and 32x32 windows, and a cross-fitted per-band gain + bias (diagonal) map with 8x8 windows; output keeps |y|

gates.rule: fixed before measurement; QB, mean of seeds 42-44 against the same-seed C2MS; other targets reported without a gate

G3_rule.pass: O3 QB SAM decrease >= 0.10 deg and RR PSNR change >= -0.04 dB

gates.decision: G1 passes -> phase 1 high-band band-ratio head (strength |H_y| kept). Else G2 passes -> phase 1 high-band strength head. Neither -> report phase 0 only. G3 passing marks O3 as a training-free candidate that still needs the full v2.3 evaluation (RR2, FR_WALD, observation ratio); it does not decide phase 1

phase1_plan.status: not started; runs only after a phase 0 gate passes and user approval

arms.H1: frozen C2MS + high-band head, MSE only (capacity control)
arms.H2: frozen C2MS + high-band head, MSE + lambda x angle (main candidate)
arms.H3: frozen C2MS + free residual head y + delta, MSE + lambda x angle (control for restricting the change to the high band)

phase1_plan.head: <= 50k parameters; inputs: L(y) band ratio, H_y, PAN high band, LMS band ratio; G1 path: output a tangent correction of the high band ratio, y' = L(y) + |H_y| * normalize(H_y/|H_y| + delta_perp); G2 path: output a per-pixel per-band positive gain of H_y; last layer zero-initialized so y' = y at start
phase1_plan.loss: MSE(y', g) + lambda x mean pixel angle (atan2 form) on the original and the 2x coarser pairs (scale mixing kept)
phase1_plan.selection: lambda and epoch by validation: minimum validation SAM among epochs whose validation PSNR >= same-seed C2MS validation PSNR - 0.02 dB; test never used for selection

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3, unchanged, against the same-seed C2MS
judgement.sam_goal: as experiment 60: QB 3-seed mean dSAM <= -0.15 deg (first) / <= -0.28 deg (stretch) with dPSNR >= -0.04 dB, reported separately

limits: phase 0 uses the RR test set already used repeatedly for exploration; O1 and O2 use the GT and are ceilings, not models
constraints: no training in phase 0; archived checkpoints are read only; writes only below results/
